meta.name: respond-phishing
meta.description: Respond to a reported phishing email following PICERL methodology. Use when a phishing email is reported or detected. Analyzes artifacts, identifies recipients who clicked, contains malicious IOCs, and removes emails from mailboxes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动响应钓鱼邮件，分析并清除威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责企业安全运营，需要快速处置钓鱼邮件
copy.tagline_en: Automatically respond to phishing emails, analyze and remove threats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle enterprise security operations and need to quickly remediate phishing emails

howto.what: 装上后，当你报告或检测到钓鱼邮件时，Claude 会按照 PICERL 方法分析邮件、识别点击者、封禁恶意指标，并从邮箱中删除邮件。
howto.when: 当你报告或检测到钓鱼邮件时触发。例如，收到可疑邮件后要求处理。

say.text: 我收到一封可疑的钓鱼邮件，请按流程处理。
say.note: Claude 会启动分析并标记恶意内容。

say.text: 请识别哪些同事点击了这封钓鱼邮件。
say.note: Claude 会查找邮件收件人并评估点击情况。

say.text: 请从所有邮箱中删除这封钓鱼邮件。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并删除相同主题或发件人的邮件。

howto.what_en: When a phishing email is reported or detected, Claude follows the PICERL methodology: analyzes email artifacts, identifies recipients who clicked, blocks malicious IOCs, and removes the email from mailboxes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user reports or detects a phishing email. No specific keywords required; just describe the incident.

say_en.text: I received a suspicious phishing email, please handle it.
say_en.note: Claude will initiate analysis and mark malicious content.

say_en.text: Identify which colleagues clicked on this phishing email.
say_en.note: Claude will search recipients and assess clicks.

say_en.text: Delete this phishing email from all mailboxes.
say_en.note: Claude will find and remove emails with same subject or sender.
